text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value
Description
returns resolved (actual) value.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_resolved_value
ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value
Return Value
returns resolved (actual) value.
Valid During
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert resolved value: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_resolved_value]."
}
Change Log
